official_feature_status.meaning: Active work is not listed as underway and no supported stack is published.

observations: dt_set_gpu() has no T6040 case and falls to unsupported chip.
rust/src/gpu/hw/mod.rs defines GpuGen only through G13 and G14.
The OF table has explicit devices only through T6022.
No explicit T6040/G16 hardware configuration is present.

mesa.reason: A future candidate is admitted only if its exact Mesa checkout exposes an explicit G16/AGX2 path. Generic generation >=14 handling is not accepted as proof.

conclusion: No maintainer-endorsed complete T6040/G16 m1n1 + Linux + firmware ABI + Mesa candidate exists in the checked sources. Keep native GPU probing disabled.
